summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for PediDrip on mobile viewport (430x900). All 8 flows in the review request passed: base readout, bolus helper (Midazolam & Epinefrin), save preset, recall, persistence across reload, delete, summary toggle + filter count, and print (no crash).

test_results.recall_saved_preset: amt=25, ml=50 applied; read-midazolam updates to 1,44 PASS
test_results.persistence_after_reload: saved entry still present after page reload (localStorage key pedidrip_saved_presets_v1) PASS
test_results.delete_saved_preset: entry removed from list and localStorage now {midazolam:[]} PASS

critical_code_review_comments: App.js deleteSaved leaves an empty array in the persisted map (e.g., {midazolam:[]}); consider pruning empty keys to keep storage tidy. Not a bug.

DrugCard bolus/summary rows share the styles.summaryRow border-top; visually fine but the 'summaryTxt' color override for bolus row relies on inline color prop; readable but consider dedicated style for clarity.
makeInitial uses BOLUS[d.id].lo as default bolusDose; for epinefrin lo=10 (henti jantung). Confirm this is the intended default vs a lower 'RJP dose' — currently OK per spec.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage key 'pedidrip_saved_presets_v1' with {midazolam:[{amt:25,ml:50}]} to test persistence/recall/delete deterministically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: react-native-web renders testID as data-testid; cards are collapsed by default — tap the drug name text to expand. Preset modal option 'Sediaan lain (isi sendiri)' can be intercepted by other list items when multiple modals stack; prefer force=True clicks or reload the page between modal interactions. Numeric readouts use Indonesian commas.
